verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's marketing says you can use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to other tools and keep mail and documents in sync, so a first-party API appears to exist. Nothing in the pack shows it is a documented public API: there is no developer reference, endpoint list, auth model, or hands-on use. Missing for 10: published API reference documentation, evidence of public/self-serve API access (keys, auth), documented endpoints for driving mailbox actions (scan, forward, shred, deposit), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
